title: Oak table in the joiner's workshop

tokens.v: Pull the linen dust sheet off it and catch that instant — the sheet mid-slide down the far side, one corner still airborne, a column of shop dust blooming up into the roof light with only the linen carrying blur. 24mm at f/5.6, camera set on the plank floor three metres back so it sits small beneath the sawtooth trusses, stacked timber running away behind. Curled shavings smear across the bottom edge, cut left and right; the tail vise handle cuts the right edge.
